newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket and dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket and dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended quiet Monday trade little changed against the dollar and the currency basket, dealers said.

The forint closed at 196.90/95 to the dollar, compared to an opening 196.95/197.00 and a midday level of 197.00/05. It remained 15-20 pips below the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid) all day.

Dealers said earlier that importers had taken a lot of foreign exchange out of the market on Friday, particularly on the Budapest Commodity Exchange futures market. They said it would take a few days for the foreign exchange to return to the market. Until then, they expected the forint to stay below its accustomed position on the NBH bid.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
